game.name: Super Mario 63
game.rules:
Download the in-game timer mod:
https://github.com/GTcreyon/sm63igt/releases/download/1.2/SM63.IGT.Pack.v1.2.zip

Alternatively, download the original game:
https://www.speedrun.com/patches/SM63_Original_dl4of.zip

You may not use flash commands (the buttons and hotkeys viewable under "Control" on the toolbar) during the run. Using them to skip the "Loading Game," copyright, and "Made by Runouw" screens is allowed for faster resets, but not if you restart the game during a run.

Left-over data from previous files may not be used. Avoid accidentally using it by restarting the game completely between runs. Left-over data can have effects such as Exit Leveling out of Bowser's Castle if you reset there the previous run, or obtaining FLUDD in the Castle after Tutorial 1 by holding shift.

You may not use any strategies that rely on other files having data in them, *with the one exception* of already having coin highscores set. Do not enter any files created before the run. If you're using the 2009 release, do not enter the level designer from the main menu without having collected 5 Star Coins during the run.

Video is required for runs beyond the beginner level (usually runs under about twice the WR time). Audio is required for world records in all categories, and for top-level runs in main categories. See category specific rules for specific cut-offs. 

The cheat code may not be used. 

Both the online and offline version of the game are allowed.

Only official releases of the game and the official in-game timer mod are allowed. Other mods are banned.

Lag glitch is banned. To avoid performing it, do not switch tabs while playing in a browser and do not minimize the window on desktop. If you are in browser, having a slow computer can also cause it. If you have that problem, you can play the downloadable version.

Abuse of resizing or minimizing the window on desktop version is banned. If you accidentally resize it by a few pixels or minimization has no significant effect, that's fine. If you wish to make the game window larger or smaller, it must remain in a 3:2 aspect ratio.

ACE, which can be performed by loading external .swf files in the level designer, is banned.

For individual levels: Real Time must be used for runs which use fludd preserve or which involve death warps until the practice hack is updated to include time spent on the title screen etc.

newsList.title: New audio requirement rule
newsList.body:
Runs which are
• Sub 6:45 in Any%
• Sub 26 in NMS
• Sub 52 in 100%
• WR in any other main game category
will be required to have audio. Background music doesn't have to be enabled, but sound effects should be audible in the video.

categories.name: No Major Skips
categories.rules:
Complete the game without bypassing the collectible requirements for accessing an area. Known major skips include:
- Entering BoB before having a shine
- Entering SSL before having 2 shines
- Entering Bowser 1 before having 8 shines
- Skipping the Tutorial 2 shine
- Entering Garden before having 10 shines.
- Entering Basement without the Bowser 1 Key.
- Entering the second part of the Basement before having the Green Star.
- Entering Bowser 2 before having 20 shines and the Green Star.
- Entering Upper Hallway (including the room with Rocket and Turbo fludd in the castle) before collecting the Bowser 2 Key.
- Entering Star Room before collecting Red Star
- Entering Bowser 3 before collecting 32 shines and the Red Star
- Collecting any of the four Star Coin Prizes without the corresponding amount of Star Coins.
- Entering Edge of the Mushroom Kingdom before collecting 63 shines


Secret passages may be used if you have the requirements to enter the area normally. You do not count as "having" a certain number of shines until you update the counter.

Be careful to perform the Bowser 2 Cutscene Skip fast enough that you actually obtain the key if you use it. It seems that you get the key when you click "save" on the save prompt that appears (clicking "don't save" doesn't work.)

Timing starts on clicking Start on the title screen and ends upon entering the final cutscene.

Times below 40 minutes need video proof to be added to the leaderboard, and times below 26 minutes need audio. Please leave milliseconds blank.

Complete the game while collecting all 64 Shine Sprites, 64 Star Coins, and 3 Bowser Keys (be careful not to do Fake Bowser Text Skip, as that skips the third key.)

Timing starts on clicking Start on the title screen and ends upon entering the final cutscene or collecting the last item.

After the run, return to the file select screen to confirm you have 100%ed the game.

Be careful to perform the Bowser 2 Cutscene Skip fast enough that you actually obtain the key if you use it. It seems that you get the key when you click "save" on the save prompt that appears (clicking "don't save" doesn't work.)

Times below 1 hour 45 minutes need video proof to be added to the leaderboard, and times below 52 minutes need audio. Please leave milliseconds blank.

First place times need to be proven with videos.

You must start from a file where no star, star coin, or FLUDD nozzle is collected in the world, otherwise your run will be rejected.

Timing starts on selecting a shine in the shine select menu, and ends when you touch the last shine (or star coin) in the level.

The Super Mario 63 Practice Hack v2.1.1 and all future versions are allowed on this leaderboard.

Huge rooms were generally pretty clean, actually. I only really lost considerable amounts of the time to the end of Huge Room 2. The end of the run was mostly clean, I just accidentally spun at the beginning of Escape 1, but besides that, it's actually fine.

I'm happy with this run :)
